name: Musée d'Orsay

summary.text: The Musée d'Orsay is a museum in Paris, France, on the Left Bank of the Seine. One of the largest art museums in Europe, it is housed in the former Gare d'Orsay, a Beaux-Arts railway station built from 1898 to 1900.
